positions.name: AsyncContractAsOperationalPrescription
positions.frame: how does the org perform a ratified contract's mechanics — as settled operational prescription rather than argument?
positions.why: Both segments state the async job contract's mechanics as operational maxims — receipt-in-seconds, polling cursor, no-blocking/no-lost-work (src-1); dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback (src-2) — using ratification language and explicit decision framing to perform the contract as adopted fact. The conviction dimension reads both at 'decision': settled and load-bearing, not argued for. The register sustains native pipeline vocabulary across both without accessibility hedging. Authority derives from having ratified the spec (power: informational/expert), not from rank or pressure. The value appeal is competence and conservation — capability preserved, stability guaranteed — stated as the goods the contract delivers, not as aspirations.
